sources.title: MmMapIoSpaceEx
sources.contract: Maps physical ranges to nonpaged system space; documented maximum IRQL is DISPATCH_LEVEL. NULL denotes insufficient mapping space.

sources.title: MmUnmapIoSpace
sources.contract: Documented maximum IRQL is DISPATCH_LEVEL; releases a prior physical-address mapping.

sources.title: KeAcquireSpinLock
sources.contract: Caller at or below DISPATCH_LEVEL; acquisition raises to DISPATCH_LEVEL, requires nonpageable protected code/data, and release restores saved IRQL.

sources.title: ZwFlushKey
sources.contract: PASSIVE_LEVEL; successful return means changed registry data was transferred to disk. The call can flush an entire hive. Merely issuing it is not durable-evidence proof.

limit: Public DDI constraints do not establish actual callback reachability, runtime IRQL or SDK26100/runtime22621 equivalence.
